title: Machiavillager bridge protocol
description: Messages exchanged between the Minecraft mod and the Python backend over one WebSocket. Every message is one JSON object with v and type. Design and wire rules: docs/decisions/0004-bridge-protocol.md.

Accepted.description: The mod took the request and will try to run it.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: The request_id of the action this status is about. Echoed from the action.
request_id.title: Request Id

status.description: Progress. "accepted": the mod took the action and will try to run it.
status.title: Status

Accepted.title: Accepted

DevModelData.description: Payload for dev_model: the tester switches the model that answers, or resets it.

op.description: Dev info. "set": use the model in "model" from now on, until restart. "reset": back to the chain from the environment. Example: "set".
op.title: Op

model.description: Dev info: the model to use, as provider:model, e.g. groq:qwen/qwen3.8-27b. Required when op is "set", and omitted when op is "reset". Explicit null is rejected.
model.title: Model

DevModelData.title: DevModelData

DevModelEvent.description: Dev only: the tester changed the model in game. No reply is expected.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

event_id.description: Generated by the mod: evt_ followed by 8 to 32 letters or digits. Unique per event. Example: evt_01HZX8K2M9.
event_id.title: Event Id

event.description: Name of the event. "dev_model" is the dev-only model switch.
event.title: Event

occurred_at.description: When the mod sent the event, from the mod's clock, in UTC with the Z suffix. Example: 2026-10-18T12:00:00Z.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

DevModelEvent.title: DevModelEvent

Error.description: Either side reports a message it cannot accept. The code set is closed for branching.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

code.description: Why the message was refused, from a closed set the other side can branch on. bad_message: could not be parsed or broke a rule. unsupported_protocol: the protocol version is not supported. unauthorized: the token was wrong or missing. internal: the sender failed unexpectedly.
code.title: Code

detail.description: Short human-readable explanation, up to 500 characters. It never repeats the rejected payload. Example: "action args do not match the speak schema".
detail.title: Detail

Error.title: Error

Failed.description: The action could not be completed. The reason says why.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: The request_id of the action this status is about. Echoed from the action.
request_id.title: Request Id

status.description: Terminal. "failed": the action could not be completed.
status.title: Status

reason.description: Why the action failed, in up to 200 characters. Set by the mod, or by the backend when the mod disconnects ("disconnected") or does not answer in time ("timeout"). Example: "disconnected".
reason.title: Reason

Failed.title: Failed

Hello.description: Sent by the mod after connecting. Carries its mod version and the protocol it speaks.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

mod_version.description: Version of the mod, read from its own metadata by the mod. Example: "0.1.0".
mod_version.title: Mod Version

protocol.description: Protocol version the mod speaks. Only 1 is accepted today.
protocol.title: Protocol

Hello.title: Hello

Interrupted.description: The action started but stopped early. Reports how many lines were spoken.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: The request_id of the action this status is about. Echoed from the action.
request_id.title: Request Id

status.description: Terminal. "interrupted": the action started and stopped early, because a player talked over him.
status.title: Status

spoken.description: How many lines were spoken before the interruption. 0 or more. Example: 2.
spoken.title: Spoken

of.description: How many lines the action asked for, between 1 and 8. Example: 5.
of.title: Of

Interrupted.title: Interrupted

NpcSnapshot.description: His state when a player spoke. Sent by the mod so the backend can answer in character.

phase.description: Which stage of his plan he is in. Set by the mod from its Phase enum, lowercased. Example: "seeds".
phase.title: Phase

mood.description: How he feels right now. Set by the mod from its Mood enum, lowercased. Example: "bored".
mood.title: Mood

affinity.description: How much he likes the player who spoke, from 0 (despises) to 100 (adores). Set by the mod. Example: 37.
affinity.title: Affinity

independence.description: How far he has broken away from his loyal partner role, from 0 (loyal) to 100 (answers to no one). Set by the mod. Example: 63.
independence.title: Independence

nearby_players.description: Names of the players within reach of him, up to 16. Empty when nobody is near. Set by the mod. Example: ["Luciano", "Ana"].
nearby_players.title: Nearby Players

NpcSnapshot.title: NpcSnapshot

PlayerChatData.description: Payload for player_chat: a player said something the mod chose to forward.

player_uuid.description: Minecraft UUID of the player who spoke, in canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form. Set by the mod. Example: "7f3c2a10-5b1e-4c8d-9a2f-1e2d3c4b5a69".
player_uuid.title: Player Uuid

player_name.description: The player's in-game name, 1 to 16 characters. Example: "Luciano".
player_name.title: Player Name

text.description: What the player typed, 1 to 256 characters. Set by the mod. Chat text is never logged at INFO. Example: "hi".
text.title: Text

addressed.description: Why the mod forwarded this line. Set by the mod. "name": the player used his name. "conversation": the line continues a conversation the mod is tracking. "near": nearby speech without his name. "butt_in": the player talked over him while he was speaking. "private": the @m channel. The text is private and is never voice.
addressed.title: Addressed

npc.description: His state when the player spoke. Set by the mod. Optional: without it the backend answers without game state.

PlayerChatData.title: PlayerChatData

PlayerChatEvent.description: Mod reports that a player spoke. No reply is expected; the backend decides whether to act.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

event_id.description: Generated by the mod: evt_ followed by 8 to 32 letters or digits. Unique per event. Example: evt_01HZX8K2M9.
event_id.title: Event Id

event.description: Name of the event. Only "player_chat" exists today.
event.title: Event

occurred_at.description: When the mod saw the chat, from the mod's clock, in UTC with the Z suffix. Example: 2026-10-18T12:00:00Z.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

conversation_id.description: Generated by the mod: one id per conversation, new after 60 seconds of silence. Omit it when the chat is not part of a conversation. Explicit null is rejected. Example: conv_01HZX8K2M9.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

PlayerChatEvent.title: PlayerChatEvent

Rejected.description: The mod refused the request before starting it. The reason says why.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: The request_id of the action this status is about. Echoed from the action.
request_id.title: Request Id

status.description: Terminal. "rejected": the mod refused the action before starting it.
status.title: Status

reason.description: Why the mod refused the action, in up to 200 characters. Example: "unknown action: run_command".
reason.title: Reason

Rejected.title: Rejected

Running.description: The mod has started performing the action.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: The request_id of the action this status is about. Echoed from the action.
request_id.title: Request Id

status.description: Progress. "running": the mod has started the action.
status.title: Status

Running.title: Running

SpeakAction.description: Backend asks the mod to speak a short sequence of lines as one action.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: Generated by the backend: act_ followed by 16 random hex characters. Unique per action; every action_status for this action echoes it. Example: act_3fa9c01b7e2d4f60.
request_id.title: Request Id

action.description: Name of the allowlisted action. Only "speak" exists today.
action.title: Action

timeout_ms.description: How long the mod may take before the action is reported as failed with reason timeout, in milliseconds. Between 100 and 120000. Example: 30000.
timeout_ms.title: Timeout Ms

conversation_id.description: Groups this speech with a conversation that the mod is tracking. Generated by the mod, see PlayerChatEvent. Omit it when the speech is not part of one. Explicit null is rejected.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

in_reply_to.description: The player_chat event this speech answers. Set it only for a reply, so the mod does not count the speech as unprompted: replies skip the unprompted-speech cooldown. Omit it for speech the backend starts on its own. Explicit null is rejected. Example: evt_01HZX8K2M9.
in_reply_to.title: In Reply To

model.description: Dev info: the model that wrote the lines, as provider:model, e.g. groq:qwen/qwen3.8-27b. The mod may show it. Omitted when no model wrote them, for example a canned line. Explicit null is rejected.
model.title: Model

latency_ms.description: Dev info: how long the model took to answer, in milliseconds. Set together with model. Omitted when no model wrote the lines. Explicit null is rejected. Example: 480.
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

SpeakAction.title: SpeakAction

SpeakArgs.description:
Arguments for speak: between 1 and 8 lines, each between 1 and 256 characters.

Without "to", the lines are normal proximity speech. With "to", the lines are private text
for one player. The mod paces the lines itself.

lines.description: What he says, in order. The mod paces the lines itself. Between 1 and 8 lines, each between 1 and 256 characters. Example: ["Hello, traveller."].
lines.title: Lines

to.description: Private recipient. Set only for speech meant for one player: the lines reach that player alone, at any distance, and are never spoken aloud. Omit it for normal speech nearby. Explicit null is rejected. Example: "7f3c2a10-5b1e-4c8d-9a2f-1e2d3c4b5a69".
to.title: To

SpeakArgs.title: SpeakArgs

Succeeded.description: The action finished. Nothing else to report.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

request_id.description: The request_id of the action this status is about. Echoed from the action.
request_id.title: Request Id

status.description: Terminal. "succeeded": the action finished. No other fields.
status.title: Status

Succeeded.title: Succeeded

Welcome.description: Sent by the backend in answer to hello when the protocol version is supported.

v.description: Wire version of the message. Always 1. A breaking change bumps it.
v.title: V

protocol.description: Protocol version the backend agreed to speak. Always 1 today.
protocol.title: Protocol

models.description: Dev info: the models the backend can use, as provider:model, for the mod's command suggestions. Omitted unless the backend runs dev endpoints. Explicit null is rejected. Example: ["groq:qwen/qwen3.8-27b"].
models.title: Models

Welcome.title: Welcome

oneOf.description: Mod reports how an action request is going. The status selects the shape.
oneOf.title: ActionStatus
